mostWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane patch was most worthwhile: the picture made the two layers understandable and explained why oxygen crosses more easily than water.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the water channel felt a little predictable because its picture and the goal already showed its purpose.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless. At the last choice, I preferred putting both proteins in one membrane, though the plain patch was also offered.

continue.text: I’d probably try another chapter: building the boundary made the pictures useful, and I’m curious how the game connects cells to larger body parts.
